sentences.text: The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal relates to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 587 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioner will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE sou.
